BiblicalUsage: Proskarteresis means perseverance, persistence in prayer. It appears once, at the end of the armour of God: praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe perseverance is the watchman's part of prayer: I pray, and then I keep watching, and I keep praying, for all the saints.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
